title: Auguste Forel on Ants and Neurology
lineage: Inspected provider-rendered passages or catalog as specified; local file is attributed research notes, not a copy of the source.

passages.note: Abstract and p. 289: Forel formulated a neuron theory in 1887; Waldeyer’s 1891 review synthesized earlier findings, articulated neuron doctrine, and introduced neuron terminology. Historians contest how credit is apportioned.
